name: GetCrux
tagline: Creative OS for launching high performing ads

colors.name: Crux Orange
colors.role: primary accent — logo mark, highlight words, slashes, CTAs on dark

colors.name: Crux Indigo
colors.role: wordmark text and headlines on light backgrounds

colors.name: Charcoal
colors.role: body text and primary CTA pill on light backgrounds

colors.name: Ink
colors.role: dark section backgrounds (data stories, product shots)

colors.name: Signal Mint
colors.role: small tags and positive data points on dark — small areas only

colors.name: Agent Violet
colors.role: chart highlight bars on dark — small areas only

fonts.notes: Headlines: GetCruxHeadline (Clash Grotesk Semibold), usually UPPERCASE for statement headlines, tight line-height ~1.05; mixed-case allowed for case-study style headlines. Body & CTA: GetCruxBody / GetCruxBodyBold. Never use other font families.

logo.clearSpace: Keep clear space equal to the height of the orange mark on all sides; nothing overlaps the wordmark.

colourways.on-dark: white wordmark, or the orange mark alone
colourways.on-photo-or-busy: white wordmark inside an ink pill, or full-colour inside a white pill

logo.placement: Top-left (case-study style) or bottom-left; the orange mark alone may be used as a large decorative element bleeding off a corner. Exactly one wordmark per design.

card.notes: Cards are used sparingly; most GetCrux layouts put text directly on Paper or Ink backgrounds with generous margins.

cta.notes: Short, uppercase-friendly copy: 'BOOK A DEMO', 'Get your free brand scan', 'Read the case study'.

productStrip.notes: The four agent stages; can appear as a small uppercase strip.

recipes: A) Case-study card — background #FDFBF5. Logo full-colour top-left at margin, width 0.24W. stack x=0.07W y=0.36H width=0.86W children: [label '//Case Study' or '//Insight' in #F26524 (role label), headline mixed-case in #2B3A8F 0.07S with the key number/word emphasised by being its own short line, (subhead charcoal)]. Optional faint diamond outline decor (shape rect rotated 45°, color #F26524, opacity 0.08) in a corner. CTA charcoal pill bottom-left.

B) Data story on ink — background #141414. stack x=0.07W y=0.1H width=0.86W children: [label uppercase in #3DD68C, headline UPPERCASE white 0.07S, subhead white at 0.8 opacity]. Lower half: product-ui dashboard shot (width 0.86W) or a generated abstract chart illustration; logo white bottom-left; CTA orange pill with white text.

C) Statement hero — background #FCE5DA (peach). Headline UPPERCASE in #333333 centred 0.075S inside a stack align center at y=0.12H; CTA charcoal pill centred; the orange mark (logo variant mark) huge (width 0.55W) bleeding off the bottom-right corner at opacity 0.9; wordmark full-colour top-left.
D) Stat — background #FDFBF5 or #141414. stack children: [stat e.g. '$1.1M' in #F26524 0.2S, headline in #2B3A8F/white 0.06S, legal source line]. Logo opposite corner.

E) Product hero — background #141414. stack top with UPPERCASE white headline + subhead; product-ui screenshot anchored bottom (width 0.8W, may bleed 10% off the bottom); mint label chip above headline; logo white bottom-left; CTA orange.

9:16.note: Meta Stories/Reels: keep text, CTA and logo out of the top 14% and bottom 35%.

voice.tone: Direct, data-backed, a little provocative. Speaks to growth marketers and creative teams. Numbers and proof over adjectives. Uppercase statements for big claims; plain sentences for insights.
headlinePatterns: Proof: 'GetCrux saved $1.1M worth of Search Ad wastage'
Speed: 'From 4 weeks to 4 minutes per ad'
Reframe: 'You don't just need more ads. You need a tighter feedback loop.'
Insight: '88% of athleisure ads started in the last 28 days'
avoid: lowercase brand name variants other than 'getcrux.' in the logo

imagery.marks: The orange X mark (four diamonds) can be used large as a decorative element, cropped off a corner, or small as a bullet. The '//' slash pair in orange is the eyebrow/label motif.
imagery.productUI: Dark-mode dashboard and agent screenshots are the hero imagery for product messaging.
imagery.photos: Team and customer photos are candid and bright; crop into rounded rectangles on Paper backgrounds.
imagery.charts: Data stories use rounded horizontal bars on Ink, one highlighted bar in violet or mint, muted grey for the rest.
imagery.illustrations: Minimal geometric, orange + indigo on paper; never clip-art.

rules: Use only brand palette colours for backgrounds, text, shapes and CTAs.
Headlines in GetCruxHeadline; body and CTA text in GetCruxBody/GetCruxBodyBold.
Exactly one wordmark per design, at least 16% of canvas width, with clear space; the mark alone may appear as decor in addition.
Full-colour wordmark on light backgrounds; white wordmark on Ink or photos.
Headline ≤ 70 characters; big claims in UPPERCASE, insights in sentence case.
One CTA per design, pill-shaped: charcoal on light, orange on dark.
Text contrast must meet WCAG AA (4.5:1).
Respect platform safe zones (Meta 9:16: top 14%, bottom 35%).
Keep text and the logo at least 7% away from canvas edges.
Lead with a number or a proof point whenever one exists.

imageStyles.illustration: Minimal flat geometric illustration in the GetCrux style: orange (#F26524) and indigo (#2B3A8F) shapes on a transparent background, diamond and slash motifs, clean edges, no gradients except a subtle warm glow, confident tech-marketing feel. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers or logos. Isolated subject on a fully transparent background.
imageStyles.photo: Editorial photograph of a modern growth-marketing team at work, bright natural light, candid, laptops and screens, warm tones. No text or logos anywhere. Compose with the subject’s face in the upper-middle of the frame with clear headroom, so the image survives cropping.
imageStyles.background: Abstract minimal background: soft peach-to-white gradient (#FCE5DA to #FDFBF5) with faint thin diamond outlines, flat, no text.
imageStyles.charm: Small flat icon in orange (#F26524) on transparent background, geometric, no text.
